findings.issue: Service worker dynamic import rejected by HTML specification
findings.change: Static test probe import for large documents; extension-page import for IndexedDB history
findings.evidence: First large-document and trace-journal Chrome fixture logs retained separately

findings.issue: Empty source details rendered numeric zero
findings.change: Boolean conditional for empty details; screenshot review and browser regression

findings.issue: Large cited document result truncated before goal review; missing citations could be usable
findings.change: Bounded document-reference handling matching existing Wiki evidence policy; citation-required regression

findings.issue: Large document offsets beyond 40000 lost during context compaction
findings.change: Shared 4M limit, distinct original/text hashes, post-compaction authorized reread regression

findings.issue: Cancelled final public events can be rejected before journal append
findings.change: Final sequence records missing tail without replaying actions or reviving cancelled tasks

findings.issue: Capture fixture counted the new history disclosure as a third capture
findings.change: Exclude journal disclosures from capture count/expansion while preserving all image, pixel, download and approval assertions

findings.issue: Final coordinator handoff dropped from recent 32 steps when active pin was released
findings.change: Retain the 32 most recently updated identities while displaying them in original start order. Preserve final coordinator/parent completion and short nested fill/verify order; internal revisions never enter public events.

findings.issue: Task-plan fixture selected nested journal summary as well as outer trace summary
findings.change: Use direct-child summary selectors for task-plan, script-recovery, page-skills and feedback. Keep original task completion/reload/step assertions.

findings.issue: Chrome managed policy read delayed boot while a slow page response remained pending
findings.change: Bound UI wait to five seconds, single-flight raw reads, fail closed until known, generation-check late responses. Capture fixture starts extension before opening intentionally held page.

findings.issue: New policy fixture incorrectly expected policy in GET_STATE
findings.change: Read state via GET_STATE and actual policy via existing GET_BROWSER_ROUTINES.

findings.issue: Policy-unknown error lost at script error normalization; managed revocation waited for policy I/O
findings.change: Preserve browser_policy_invalid classification and immediately cancel active work when policy changes, independently of the pending policy read.

findings.issue: GET_STATE received after a long tool was queued but before it started could wait behind a native dialog until its timeout
findings.change: Reserve queued/running long tool operations before enqueue, release on every outcome, and let trusted UI read current state without recovery while any reservation exists. Actual-host deterministic regression covers the queued boundary, denied untrusted observers and multiple/error releases.
